question: For each IAP category, list its name, number of unique sessions, total number of attendees, active period (in the format of 'beginning term code-end term code'), the most common sponsor name, and the most common session start time. Include a grand total row showing the total number of sessions and attendees across all categories in the format of ('TOTAL', number of sessions, number of attendees, null, null, null).

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    d.TERM_CODE,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    s.SESSION_START_TIME
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
    ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
    ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
),
cat AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS sessions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY) AS attendees,
    CONCAT(MIN(TERM_CODE), '-', MAX(TERM_CODE)) AS period
  FROM base
  GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
),
sp AS (
  SELECT
    b.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    sp.SPONSOR_NAME,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

    ) AS rn
  FROM base b
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp
    ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = b.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

  GROUP BY b.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, b.SESSION_START_TIME

  (SELECT SESSION_START_TIME FROM st WHERE st.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = cat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND rn = 1) AS start_time
FROM cat
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'TOTAL',
  COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY),
  COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY),
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL
FROM base

  SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS unique_sessions,
    COUNT(*) AS total_attendees,

  FROM base
  GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
),

  SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, SPONSOR_NAME,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SPONSOR_NAME) AS rn

  GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, SPONSOR_NAME
),

  SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, SESSION_START_TIME,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SESSION_START_TIME) AS rn
  FROM base
  WHERE SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, SESSION_START_TIME
),

  SELECT
    cs.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    cs.unique_sessions,
    cs.total_attendees,
    cs.active_period,
    sm.SPONSOR_NAME AS most_common_sponsor,
    tm.SESSION_START_TIME AS most_common_start_time

  LEFT JOIN sponsor_mode sm ON cs.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = sm.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND sm.rn = 1

    COUNT(*) AS total_attendees,
    NULL AS active_period,
    NULL AS most_common_sponsor,
    NULL AS most_common_start_time
  FROM base

`ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, NULL AS IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, NULL AS IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, NULL AS avg_fee, NULL AS total_activities_sponsor, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.Total_Activities, 'IAP Activity' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, s2.avg_fee, s2.total_activities AS total_activities_sponsor, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS Total_Activities, 'Category Sponsor' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, avg_fee, total_activities_sponsor, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_START_DATE, Total_Activities, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ENROLLMENT_TYPE, Source, ACTIVITY_TITLE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

WITH DepartmentActivities AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_activities FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), ActivityCategoryDetails AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY category_sort, activity_sort) = IAP_CATEGORY_NAME THEN NULL ELSE IAP_CATEGORY_NAME END AS category_name, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, activity_count, IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE IAP_CATEGORY_NAME END AS category_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE IAP_CATEGORY_NAME END AS IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACTIVITY_TITLE END AS activity_sort, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY category_sort, activity_sort) SELECT da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, acd.category_name, acd.ACTIVITY_TITLE, acd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, acd.MAX_ENROLLMENT, acd.activity_count, da.total_activities FROM ActivityCategoryDetails AS acd JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd ON acd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE JOIN DepartmentActivities AS da ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ORDER BY da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, acd.category_name, acd.ACTIVITY_TITLE

inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE) AS t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.enrolled_students_variance, ayv.department_name, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered, stv.SPONSOR_TYPE, stv.SPONSOR_NAME, stv.max_enrollment_variance FROM academic_year_variance AS ayv CROSS JOIN sponsor_type_variance AS stv ORDER BY ayv.enrolled_students_variance DESC, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, stv.max_enrollment_variance DESC

WITH ActivityStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE, t0.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CategorySponsorStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.TERM_START_DATE, a.Total_Activities, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, c.avg_fee, c.total_activities FROM ActivityStats AS a JOIN CategorySponsorStats AS c ON a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column, JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d ON inner_cte1.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inner_cte1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, VARIANCE(inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_variance, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte2.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_enrollment, s2.enrollment_variance, s2.department_phone, s2.school_name FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte.SESSION_TITLE, cte.SESSION_LOCATION, cte.SESSION_DATE, cte.SESSION_START_TIME, cte.SESSION_END_TIME, cte.min_start_time_per_location, dr.window_column, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) AS dr ON cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = dr.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND cte.TERM_CODE = dr.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cte.SESSION_LOCATION

c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, NULL AS avg_fee, NULL AS total_activities_sponsor, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.Total_Activities, 'IAP Activity' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_START_DATE, Total_Activities, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ENROLLMENT_TYPE, Source, ACTIVITY_TITLE, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME

WITH DepartmentActivities AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS total_activities FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) > 0 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), ActivityCategoryDetails AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY` AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY category_sort, activity_sort) = IAP_CATEGORY_NAME THEN NULL ELSE IAP_CATEGORY_NAME END AS category_name, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, activity_count, IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE IAP_CATEGORY_NAME END AS category_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 1 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE IAP_CATEGORY_NAME END AS IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, CASE WHEN GROUPING(IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) = 0 AND GROUPING(ACTIVITY_TITLE) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACTIVITY_TITLE END AS activity_sort, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, MAX(IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ACTIVITY_TITLE, ENROLLMENT_TYPE, MAX_ENROLLMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY category_sort, activity_sort) SELECT da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, acd.category_name, acd.ACTIVITY_TITLE, acd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, acd.MAX_ENROLLMENT, acd.activity_count, da.total_activities FROM ActivityCategoryDetails AS acd JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd ON acd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE JOIN DepartmentActivities AS da ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ORDER BY da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, acd.category_name, acd.ACTIVITY_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME), TermJoin AS (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN TermJoin AS tj ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tj.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON tj.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND tj.SPONSOR_NAME = ass.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.min_fee, s.SPONSOR_TYPE FROM inner_cte JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME = s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME

WITH academic_year_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME), sponsor_type_variance AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_TYPE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY) SELECT i.SPONSOR_TYPE, i.SPONSOR_NAME, i.max_enrollment_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT SPONSOR_TYPE FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` GROUP BY SPONSOR_TYPE) AS t ON i.SPONSOR_TYPE = t.SPONSOR_TYPE) SELECT ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayv.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ayv.enrolled_students_variance, ayv.department_name, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered, stv.SPONSOR_TYPE, stv.SPONSOR_NAME, stv.max_enrollment_variance FROM academic_year_variance AS ayv CROSS JOIN sponsor_type_variance AS stv ORDER BY ayv.enrolled_students_variance DESC, ayv.total_library_subjects_offered DESC, stv.max_enrollment_variance DESC

>= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CategorySponsorStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
         d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
         d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
         d.TERM_CODE,
         d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
         s.SESSION_START_TIME
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
),
cat AS (
  SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
         COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS sessions,
         COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY) AS attendees,
         CONCAT(MIN(TERM_CODE), '-', MAX(TERM_CODE)) AS period
  FROM base
  GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
),
sp AS (
  SELECT b.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, sp.SPONSOR_NAME,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, sp.SPONSOR_NAME) rn
  FROM base b
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR sp ON sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = b.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  GROUP BY b.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, sp.SPONSOR_NAME
),
st AS (
  SELECT b.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, b.SESSION_START_TIME,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.SESSION_START_TIME) rn
  FROM base b
  WHERE b.SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, b.SESSION_START_TIME
)
SELECT cat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
       cat.sessions,
       cat.attendees,
       cat.period,
       (SELECT SPONSOR_NAME FROM sp WHERE sp.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = cat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND rn = 1) AS sponsor,
       (SELECT SESSION_START_TIME FROM st WHERE st.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = cat.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND rn = 1) AS start_time
FROM cat
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TOTAL',
       COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY),
       COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY),
       NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM base
ORDER BY 1;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    d.TERM_CODE,
    s.SPONSOR_NAME,
    ss.SESSION_START_TIME
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY c
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d ON c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION ss ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
),
category_stats AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS unique_sessions,
    COUNT(*) AS total_attendees,
    CONCAT(MIN(TERM_CODE), '-', MAX(TERM_CODE)) AS active_period
  FROM base
  GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
),
sponsor_mode AS (
  SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, SPONSOR_NAME,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SPONSOR_NAME) AS rn
  FROM base
  WHERE SPONSOR_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, SPONSOR_NAME
),
time_mode AS (
  SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, SESSION_START_TIME,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SESSION_START_TIME) AS rn
  FROM base
  WHERE SESSION_START_TIME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, SESSION_START_TIME
),
category_results AS (
  SELECT
    cs.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    cs.unique_sessions,
    cs.total_attendees,
    cs.active_period,
    sm.SPONSOR_NAME AS most_common_sponsor,
    tm.SESSION_START_TIME AS most_common_start_time
  FROM category_stats cs
  LEFT JOIN sponsor_mode sm ON cs.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = sm.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND sm.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN time_mode tm ON cs.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = tm.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AND tm.rn = 1
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS unique_sessions,
    COUNT(*) AS total_attendees,
    NULL AS active_period,
    NULL AS most_common_sponsor,
    NULL AS most_common_start_time
  FROM base
)
SELECT * FROM category_results
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM grand_total
ORDER BY CASE WHEN IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, IAP_CATEGORY_NAME
